scripts.title: Simit and River Pebbles
scripts.rawText:
[INTENT]
Create a joyful, wondrous live-action and 2D-animation hybrid comedy scene set in a sun-drenched cobbled alleyway in Turkey, featuring @image1 as Mark and @image2 as Lucas sharing an unhurried afternoon walk mid-conversation.

[LOGIC]
Maintain a continuous Steadicam oner moving down the alley with Mark on frame-left and Lucas on frame-right, preserving natural scale with Lucas at waist height. Keep the brown paper bakery bag in Mark's left hand and the torn sesame simit in his right, and keep the whole simit in Lucas's right hand with his left hand steadying his woven straw sling bag. Ground 2D cel-shaded Lucas in the live-action space with crisp sunlit contact shadows on the cobblestones. No subtitles appear on screen.

[AESTHETIC]
Medium: 35mm live-action photography composited seamlessly with crisp hand-drawn 2D cel animation, natural film grain
Palette: warm terracotta, sun-bleached limestone, vibrant magenta bougainvillea, olive green, toasted sesame gold
Lighting: high afternoon Mediterranean sunlight, dappled leaf shadows, warm bounce light off limestone walls
Location: narrow cobbled Turkish alleyway, whitewashed stone facades, terracotta planters, overhead bougainvillea trellises, wooden shutters
Wardrobe: Mark in an open off-white linen button-down shirt with rolled sleeves over a faded terracotta crew-neck tee, sand-colored chinos, and worn tan leather loafers; Lucas in a bright teal-blue short-sleeved camp-collar shirt, khaki cargo shorts, and a small woven straw crossbody sling bag
Audio: distant tram bell, sparrows in the trellises, warm breeze through leaves, faint street chatter

[OPENING]
Low-angle Steadicam MS at waist height, framed down a sun-drenched cobbled alleyway toward sunlit limestone walls. Frame-left midground, Mark stands mid-stride facing camera, a brown paper bakery bag in his left hand and a torn piece of sesame simit in his right hand. Frame-right midground, 2D-animated Lucas stands at Mark's waist height facing camera, a whole sesame simit in his right hand and his left hand resting on his woven straw sling bag, his wide yellow gaze directed up toward overhead bougainvillea.

[EXECUTION]
[CAM 01] Steadicam low-angle MS, tracking backward ahead of Mark and Lucas -> [ACT] Mark walks forward down the cobbles frame-left, brown paper bag in his left hand and torn simit in his right, while Lucas hops in rhythm beside him frame-right, whole simit in his right hand and left hand resting on his woven straw sling bag -> <cobbles clacking under leather loafers, soft webbed slaps>
[CAM 01] Steadicam ARCING RIGHT around them to a low two-shot profile -> [ACT] Mark glances down at Lucas with an amused grin, paper bag in his left hand and torn simit in his right, while Lucas tilts his head back in wonder at the overhead bougainvillea, whole simit in his right hand and left hand on his woven straw sling bag -> Mark says amused, casual {You told the baker you were my nephew.} -> [ACT] Lucas blinks his wide yellow eyes upward, beaming as dappled sunlight slides across his green skin
[CAM 01] Steadicam PUSHING IN and CRANE-RISING over Lucas's shoulder toward Mark -> [ACT] Lucas, whole simit in his right hand and left hand steadying his woven straw sling bag, hops onto a low stone doorstep to match Mark's eye level -> Lucas says blithely, wondrous {He didn't ask which side of the family.} -> [ACT] Mark laughs softly, tearing a bite from the simit in his right hand while shifting the paper bag in his left hand
[CAM 01] Steadicam WHIP-PANNING DOWN to follow Lucas off the step, then TRACKING alongside them -> [ACT] Lucas drops lightly onto the cobbles with his camp-collar shirt fluttering, whole simit in his right hand and left hand on his woven straw sling bag, as Mark walks beside him with the paper bag in his left hand and simit in his right -> Mark says dryly, warm {Next time, don't tip him in river pebbles.} -> <soft webbed thud on cobbles, loafers scuffing stone>
[CAM 01] Steadicam PULLING BACK and CRANE-RISING high above the alleyway -> [ACT] Lucas looks up at Mark with a serene grin, whole simit in his right hand and left hand on his woven straw sling bag, while Mark walks on with the paper bag in his left hand and torn simit in his right -> Lucas says matter-of-fact {They were very round pebbles.} -> [ACT] Mark shakes his head, laughing, as both continue together down the sun-drenched alley toward the warm afternoon haze
